caption: The drawing depicts a piece of fabric laid out flat on a light-colored surface, with detailed embroidered designs. The fabric itself is a light beige or off-white color. On the left side, there is a vertical border featuring a series of closely arranged floral and plant motifs, embroidered in various colors including green, red, blue, yellow, and pink. This border is divided from the main central section by a distinct seam or fold. The central and right sections of the fabric display a more scattered arrangement of individual floral and plant motifs, each spaced apart from the others. The motifs are embroidered in similar colors to those in the border, with green leaves and stems, and flowers in red, blue, yellow, and pink. Some small birds are also present among the motifs. There is a lace or embroidered edging running along the right and bottom borders of the fabric. The entire composition is executed in fine, detailed lines and soft, natural colors against the neutral fabric background.
title: Crewel Embroidered Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
